integration_and_scheduling.procurement_strategy: Align major contract awards with project sprint release milestones and cloud infrastructure phases.
integration_and_scheduling.timetable_alignment: RFP issuance completed by Month 2, vendor selection by Month 3, contract signoff by Month 4.

roles_authority_and_metrics.roles_and_authority: Procurement Manager negotiates commercial terms, Legal approves contract templates, Project Manager authorizes scope SOWs.
roles_authority_and_metrics.vendor_metrics_slas: 99.9% uptime SLA, defect resolution SLA under 4 hours for Severity 1, and monthly deliverable audits.

contract_types_and_vendors.contract_types_selection: Firm Fixed Price (FFP) for core platform software licenses; Time & Materials (T&M) for specialized architecture consulting.
contract_types_and_vendors.vendor_selection_approach: Evaluation through weighted scoring: 40% technical competence, 30% commercial cost, 30% vendor past performance.

jurisdiction_and_risk.jurisdiction_dispute_terms: Governed by local commercial arbitration rules, billing denominated in SAR.
jurisdiction_and_risk.procurement_risk_mitigation: Dual vendor sourcing strategy for mission-critical cloud components and escrow agreements for proprietary source code.
